title: Wine doriwork lehngacholi
description:
This is a stunning wine  Lehenga Choli perfect for festive occasions or weddings. The ensemble features a lehenga (skirt), choli (blouse), and dupatta (scarf). 
 Lehenga: The lehenga is crafted from a luxurious wine pure Georgett fabric. It showcases intricate resham (thread) work in a delicate off-white or silver hue. The design is characterized by vertical lines of floral and paisley motifs that run along the length of the skirt, creating a visually elongating effect. The border of the lehenga is heavily embellished with a denser pattern, adding a touch of opulence. 
 Choli: The matching choli is also made from the same wine Georgett features a deep V-neckline. The sleeves are short and also adorned with the same resham work as the lehenga, creating a cohesive look. The embroidery on the choli is concentrated around the neckline and bust area, highlighting the upper body. 
 Dupatta: The dupatta is made from a complementary wine fabric, likely a soft georgette or a similar lightweight material. It features a wavy, scalloped border embellished with the same resham work as the lehenga and choli. The dupatta is draped to showcase the intricate work and adds a touch of elegance to the overall outfit. 
 Fabric: The primary fabric used is pure Georgette, known for its flowing drape and luxurious feel. 
 Work: The intricate resham work is the highlight of the outfit, adding a touch of traditional craftsmanship and elegance. 
 Sizes: This outfit is available in a range of sizes including L, XL, XXL, and 3XL, catering to a variety of body types. 
 This wine Georgett Lehenga Choli is a perfect blend of traditional design and modern aesthetics, making it a versatile and stylish choice for special occasions. The rich color, intricate embroidery, and flowing silhouette make it a truly eye-catching ensemble.

title: Pink handwork plazo jacket
description:
Redefine modern ethnic luxury with this exquisitely tailored Indo-Western Palazzo Set. Designed for the contemporary woman who loves to balance traditional opulence with avant-garde structure, this ensemble guarantees a head-turning silhouette. Crafted from premium fabrics and adorned with intricate, artisan handwork, it strikes the ultimate balance between high-fashion glamour and fluid comfort. Perfect for festive celebrations, sangeet nights, receptions, and luxury evening wear. 
 The Design Details 
 
 
  The Inner Spaghetti Crop Top:  A captivating focal point featuring a flattering spaghetti-strap neckline, lavishly adorned with detailed, shimmering artisan handwork that catches the light beautifully. 
 
 
  The Layered Over-Cape:  A masterpiece of modern tailoring. This structured, straight-cut cape features an elegant, almond-shaped cutout in the center that subtly reveals the hand-embroidered crop top beneath. The cape is further elevated with exquisite matching handwork and sophisticated 3/4 sleeves featuring detailed cuffs. 
 
 
  The Palazzo:  Effortless movement meets pure comfort. The flowy divider palazzo is crafted from premium Pure Simar Silk, offering a beautiful, high-sheen fluid drape that coordinates perfectly with the structured cape.

 Let the unique almond-cutout bodice and intricate handwork take center stage. Style this regal ensemble with metallic block heels, sleek pulled-back hair, and minimal statement drop earrings to let the gorgeous cape silhouette do all the talking.
